feature: F-17 Tonic and Tokio gRPC ingress
findings: A real Tonic server and client exchange 100 protobuf requests on loopback.
Every gRPC response equals the response of the framed TCP path for the same RequestHandler.
The default build without the grpc feature still passes all 63 runtime tests.
protoc 29.3 is installed locally in sheaf-db/tools/protoc and is git-ignored.
